name: Contact Handler Common Tests
purpose: Common check after the contact picker closes: reads the picker's result JSON (Get Results in Picker Module), returns -1 on cancel or when nothing was picked and no party is to be created; stops the timer; halts in layout mode; otherwise returns the results.
open_question: Called by the selection handlers (66, 676, 719, 722). Result code -1 vs -2 differs from the address handler (-2).

name: Address Handler Common Tests
purpose: Common check after the address picker closes: reads the result JSON, returns -2 on cancel or when no address was picked/created, stops the timer, otherwise returns the results.

name: Phone Handler Common Tests
purpose: Common check after the phone picker closes: reads the result JSON, returns -1 when empty or nothing selected (ContactId), stops the timer, otherwise returns the results.
open_question: The 'empty results' branch stops the timer; the 'nothing selected' branch (step 22) does not.
